## About me

I am a Ph.D. candidate in the 
[Department of Industrial Engineering and Operations Research](https://ieor.berkeley.edu/) 
at the [University of California, Berkeley](https://www.berkeley.edu/), 
advised by [Prof. Thibaut Mastrolia](https://ieor.berkeley.edu/people/thibaut-mastrolia/). 

Previously, I received my B.S. with Honors in 
[Mathematics](https://math.utexas.edu/) from 
[The University of Texas at Austin](https://www.utexas.edu/) in 2023, 
where I worked under the supervision of 
[Prof. Thaleia Zariphopoulou](https://math.utexas.edu/directory/thaleia-zariphopoulou).

My research lies at the intersection of stochastic control, contract theory, 
and reinforcement learning, with a particular focus on financial, cyber, and AI
systems involving risk, strategic behavior, and model uncertainty.

## Research interests

- Backward stochastic differential equations, including second-order BSDEs
- Hawkes processes and self-exciting stochastic systems
- Continous time reinforcement learning
- Cyber risk management and resilient cyber systems
